heroBanner.label: Our Mission
heroBanner.title: Vision & Mission
heroBanner.text: Repositioning culture as a central pillar of global sustainability and planetary stewardship.

executiveSummary.label: Executive Summary
executiveSummary.text: The Cultural Resilience, One Planet (CROP) Conference 2026 represents a transformative moment in global sustainability discourse. For too long, culture has been treated as peripheral to environmental and development agendas. This conference boldly repositions culture as a central pillar of planetary stewardship.
executiveSummary.text3: international Indigenous and cultural leaders, policymakers, academics, private sector innovators, and youth changemakers, CROP 2026 will forge new pathways for integrating cultural resilience into global sustainability frameworks.
executiveSummary.text4: Through three intensive days of dialogue, collaboration, and action, we will co-create strategies that honor cultural diversity while addressing the urgent challenges facing our shared planet.
